ltv_segment.transformationDescription: CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.lifetime_spend_brl, 0.0) >= 500.0 THEN 'High Value VIP' WHEN COALESCE(s.lifetime_spend_brl, 0.0) >= 150.0 THEN 'Mid Tier Core' ELSE 'Low Tier Standard' END AS ltv_segment

buyer_type.transformationDescription: CASE WHEN total_orders_placed > 1 THEN 'repeat_buyer' ELSE 'single_buyer' END AS buyer_type

weight_class.transformationDescription: CASE WHEN weight_g IS NULL THEN 'unknown' WHEN weight_g < 500 THEN 'lightweight' WHEN weight_g < 2000 THEN 'medium_weight' ELSE 'heavyweight' END AS weight_class

seller_tier.transformationDescription: CASE WHEN total_merchandise_revenue > 10000 THEN 'tier_1_top_seller' WHEN total_merchandise_revenue > 2000 THEN 'tier_2_growth_seller' ELSE 'tier_3_standard_seller' END AS seller_tier

is_delayed_delivery.transformationDescription: CASE WHEN o.delivered_customer_at > o.estimated_delivery_at THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_delayed_delivery

is_credit_card_payment.transformationDescription: CASE WHEN p.payment_type = 'credit_card' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_credit_card_payment

is_split_installment.transformationDescription: CASE WHEN p.payment_installments > 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_split_installment

delayed_orders_count.transformationDescription: SUM(CASE WHEN is_delayed_delivery THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delayed_orders_count

delay_rate_percentage.transformationDescription: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_delayed_delivery THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(order_id), 0), 2) AS delay_rate_percentage

volume_cm3.transformationDescription: CAST(COALESCE(p.product_length_cm, 0) * COALESCE(p.product_height_cm, 0) * COALESCE(p.product_width_cm, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS volume_cm3
